Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Paul Tracy as the champion of the 1998 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach without verifying this claim through multiple credible sources. This error occurred at the very beginning when the agent relied on incomplete or ambiguous information from WebSurfer and failed to implement a robust verification strategy. The Planner subsequently issued repetitive instructions to WebSurfer to confirm the winner, perpetuating the error before it was corrected in later steps. This initial mistake led to confusion and redundant attempts to validate the champion's identity throughout the conversation.
